case_selection: All tables for (n,s)=(2,2),(2,4),(3,3), unchanged from the previous audit.
cost_model: New work units include signature bit widths, generated states, every refinement rebuild, bounded relaxation and full verification. They are logical accounting events, not exact bit operations or time. Only the two new variants use the same ledger; the old search ledger is reported separately and is not a speedup denominator.
iteration_encoding: Round examples are the first sample_count entries of the run examples. Round ledgers are abbreviated; aggregate run ledgers include every metric. Certificate IDs index region_certificates and are assigned only after search.
scope: Sound finite sample-state pruning; no general polynomial bound or P vs NP conclusion.
